title: Modern JavaScript & the DOM
description: A complete 16-lesson JavaScript track combining modern ES2025+ syntax with hands-on DOM playgrounds, from data types, closures, Map/Set, and localStorage to debouncing, async/await, and ES Modules.
outcomes: Master modern JavaScript types, strict equality, loops, functions, and closures
Work fluently with arrays, objects, destructuring, spread, Map, Set, and .reduce()
Manipulate the DOM safely, handle delegated events, and persist state in localStorage
Write resilient async/await code, debounced inputs, ES Modules, and clean error handling
Build a complete interactive Task Tracker app from scratch
